about: How the tools of a modlist name and mark the plugins they make (TL01). ModTrap's data, not code: one entry a tool, each with where the fact was read and how sure it is. 'kind' decides what ModTrap proposes for such a plugin when a mod it depends on is taken out: a patcher's or generator's output is made again by running the tool; an editor's output cannot be made again by ModTrap and is demastered.

tools.label: FACT for the default name; a group's own name is the owner's choice
FACT that it is an editor; what it wrote came from a script or from hand edits
